name: Gochujang Turkey & Sweet Potato Bowls
subtitle: Glazed ground turkey with edamame, roasted sweet potato and green beans, quick cucumber pickle

macros.portion: About 1 cup turkey and edamame, 1 cup roasted sweet potato, ½ cup green beans and 1 cup quick cucumber.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: **2 lb ground turkey** thawed in the fridge.
notes: A Korean-American fusion bowl, not a traditional Korean dish. The glaze reduces in the turkey skillet, so there's no separate saucepan. Brown the turkey hard before the glaze goes in; steamed grey turkey won't take on the sauce.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.body: Racks lower-middle and upper-middle. An **empty sheet pan** on the lower rack. Heat to 425°F.

steps.title: Sweet potatoes in
steps.body: Cut **2½ lb sweet potatoes** into ¾-inch cubes and toss with **1 Tbsp neutral oil + ¾ tsp salt**. Spread on the hot pan, lower rack. Roast **15 min**.

steps.title: Prep while it roasts
steps.body: Toss **1 lb green beans** in the same bowl with **2 tsp neutral oil + ¼ tsp salt** and spread on the second pan. Slice **2 cucumbers** into thin half-moons and toss with **¼ cup rice vinegar + 1 tsp sugar + ½ tsp salt**; refrigerate. Whisk **¼ cup gochujang + 3 Tbsp soy sauce + 2 Tbsp honey + 1 Tbsp rice vinegar + 2 tsp sesame oil + ¼ cup water** smooth. Mince **4 cloves garlic**, grate **1 Tbsp ginger**, slice **4 scallions** (whites and greens apart). Microwave **1½ cups edamame** **2 min** to thaw.

steps.title: Flip, and green beans in
steps.body: At the 15-minute mark, flip the sweet potatoes. Green beans onto the upper rack. Roast both **12–15 min**, until the potatoes brown at the edges and the beans blister.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.body: Skillet over medium-high, **1 tsp neutral oil**. Press in **2 lb turkey** in a flat layer and leave it **5 min** to brown. Break it up and cook **4 min** more. Spoon off any pooled fat.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.body: Add the **garlic, ginger and scallion whites** and stir 1 min. Add the **glaze** and the **edamame**. Simmer **3–4 min**, stirring, until the sauce reduces and clings to the turkey. Off heat: **1 Tbsp sesame seeds** and the scallion greens.

steps.title: Build the bowls
steps.body: Pull both pans. Sweet potatoes on the bottom, turkey on top, green beans alongside, cucumbers drained and on the side.

after: Pack 3 lunches: sweet potato, turkey and green beans. Cucumbers go in a separate small container.
